title: Moon Base Challenge
level: High school and post-secondary students (U.S. schools)
about: NASA student design challenge inviting teams from U.S. high schools and post-secondary schools to propose Moon Base solutions in power, construction, life support, surface mobility, communications and astronaut safety. Registration through NASA STEM Gateway closes 25 January 2027.
requirements: Student teams at U.S. high schools and post-secondary schools
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Moon Base Challenge at NASA, United States, deadline 25 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline and the Empire State Building in New York.
